svg.title: The Allen CCF frame beside the IBL frame
svg.desc: The same side view of the mouse brain twice, anterior on the left and dorsal at the top, inside the box that is the atlas volume. In the Allen CCF the origin is the anterior, dorsal, left corner of the volume, in micrometres, with AP increasing towards posterior, DV towards ventral and ML towards the right. In the IBL frame the origin is bregma, a little behind the front third of the volume and just below its top, in metres, with AP increasing towards anterior, DV towards dorsal and ML towards the right.

g.text: AP + towards posterior, DV + towards ventral,
Origin: anterior, dorsal, left corner of the volume
Axis order in the files: AP, DV, ML
Bregma sits at ML 5739, AP 5400, DV 332
AP + towards anterior, DV + towards dorsal,
Origin: bregma, on the skull surface
Units: metres; depth below bregma is negative
The box is the same volume as on the left
